name: ASCIIText-TS-TW
blurb: Text rendered as ASCII art with 3D waves and mouse-tracking tilt.
description: Renders text as ASCII characters in a 3D plane with wave deformations and perspective tilt driven by mouse position. Uses WebGL shaders and canvas manipulation.
use_when: A hero heading needs a striking retro-terminal effect with 3D depth and interactivity.
avoid_when: On touch-only devices or low-end GPUs — requires WebGL and continuous canvas rendering.
a11y: Text is rendered as canvas and ASCII output; screen readers cannot reach it. No keyboard interaction.
